sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from a recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side struggling badly at the foot of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results fall their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host struggling Eccleshall at home. Wolverhampton Casuals face mid-table Wednesfield Community in a Saturday fixture before the two sides meet again on Wednesday evening at Brereton Social. The title race remains tight with just three points separating the top four. Bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town visit Brereton Social in what appears a critical fixture for the hosts, who occupy the lower reaches of the table. Barnton host Shawbury United on Saturday, with Shawbury on a concerning run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills, while Foley Meir host Bilston Town—Bilston fifth with strong recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads face away trip to Telford Town, and Crewe visit Allscott Heath in a match between mid-table sides.
